`root` sets `line-height: 2` as a unitless value. Unitless `line-height` is inherited as the multiplier itself (not as a resolved pixel length), so `root>big` inherits `line-height: 2` and applies it to its own `font-size: 32px`. Thus its line height is `2 × 32px = 64px`, and since it contains a single line of text, its height is 64px.

ANSWER: 64
